name: local-autocomplete
description: Inline code completions from a local LLM (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM), switchable per file, per language, or everywhere from the status bar.

localAutocomplete.enable.markdownDescription: Turn inline completions on or off everywhere. When off, nothing is sent to the model, whatever the per-language and per-file settings say. Also available from the status bar.

localAutocomplete.disabledLanguages.markdownDescription: [Language identifiers](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/languages/identifiers) where completions are off, for example `markdown` or `plaintext`. A single file can still be turned back on from the status bar menu.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Any server with an OpenAI-style `/v1/completions` endpoint: LM Studio, llama.cpp's `llama-server`, vLLM, LocalAI, …

A server that answers **only** `/v1/chat/completions` and returns 404 for `/v1/completions`. The prompt is sent as one user message. Made for gateways and proxies, not for good completions: chat models are trained to talk, so set `#localAutocomplete.fimTemplate#` to `custom` and write an instruction prompt.
localAutocomplete.provider.description: The kind of server that runs the model.

localAutocomplete.endpoint.markdownDescription: Base URL of the server, including a path prefix such as `/v1`. Leave empty for the default of `#localAutocomplete.provider#`: `http://127.0.0.1:11434` for Ollama, `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1` for OpenAI-compatible servers (LM Studio's default; `llama-server` listens on `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`).

localAutocomplete.model.markdownDescription: Model name as the server knows it. Use a code model trained for fill-in-the-middle, preferably a base (non-instruct) variant. Run **Local Autocomplete: Select Model** to choose from the models on the server.

localAutocomplete.apiKey.deprecationMessage: The API key now lives in your keychain. Run "Local Autocomplete: Set API Key" and delete this setting.
localAutocomplete.apiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated: only read once, to move an existing key into secret storage.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Choose from the model name. Unrecognized models get the Qwen format.
StarCoder, StarCoder2, Granite Code, Stable Code: `<fim_prefix>…<fim_suffix>…<fim_middle>`
localAutocomplete.fimTemplate.markdownDescription: Fill-in-the-middle prompt format. Each model family is trained on its own special tokens, and a mismatch gives poor or empty completions.

localAutocomplete.customFimTemplate.markdownDescription: Prompt used when `#localAutocomplete.fimTemplate#` is `custom`. `{prefix}` is replaced with the code before the cursor and `{suffix}` with the code after it. Add the model's end-of-text tokens to `#localAutocomplete.stopSequences#`.

localAutocomplete.stopSequences.markdownDescription: Extra sequences that end a completion, on top of the ones that come with the prompt format.

enumDescriptions: Multi-line on empty lines and after an opening bracket or colon at the end of a line; single-line elsewhere.
localAutocomplete.multiline.description: When completions may span several lines.

localAutocomplete.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate per completion.

localAutocomplete.temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Lower values give more predictable completions.

localAutocomplete.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before asking the model, in milliseconds.

localAutocomplete.maxPrefixChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters before the cursor to send as context (roughly 3-4 characters per token). More context can improve completions but makes requests slower, and the prompt has to fit the model's context window: see `#localAutocomplete.maxContextTokens#`.

localAutocomplete.maxSuffixChars.description: Maximum number of characters after the cursor to send as context.

localAutocomplete.stream.markdownDescription: Read the reply as it is generated and cancel the request as soon as the completion is settled, instead of waiting for the model to spend all of `#localAutocomplete.maxTokens#`. The ghost text still appears in one piece, because VS Code shows a completion all at once, but it appears sooner and the model's remaining work is dropped.

localAutocomplete.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long to wait for the server, in milliseconds. With `#localAutocomplete.stream#` on, this is the wait allowed between pieces of the reply, so a slow start still gets the full time. Loading a model into memory for the first request can take a minute or two.

localAutocomplete.maxContextTokens.markdownDescription: The largest context window to ask Ollama to reserve, in tokens (`num_ctx`). It is only sent when the prompt plus `#localAutocomplete.maxTokens#` needs more than Ollama's own default of 4096, so a context you configured in Ollama is never lowered. Ollama cuts the front off a prompt that does not fit, without telling the extension, which is why this matters. Set to 0 to never send it. A bigger window uses more memory and can push the model out of your GPU.

localAutocomplete.keepAlive.markdownDescription: How long Ollama keeps the model loaded after a request: `5m`, `30s`, `-1` to keep it forever, `0` to unload it right away. Leave empty for Ollama's own default of 5 minutes. Only Ollama uses this setting.

localAutocomplete.commitMessageModel.markdownDescription: Model that drafts commit messages. Leave empty to use `#localAutocomplete.model#`. An instruct model follows the instructions; a base fill-in-the-middle model usually does not, and writes a poor message.

localAutocomplete.commitMessageMaxDiffCh.markdownDescription: Maximum characters of the diff sent when generating a commit message. A longer diff is cut from the end, and the model is told it was cut. Has to fit the context window: see `#localAutocomplete.maxContextTokens#`.

enumDescriptions: The icon followed by the word Autocomplete.
No status bar item. Use the Local Autocomplete commands from the Command Palette instead.
localAutocomplete.showStatusBar.description: How much of the status bar this extension takes up.
